lines.t: First election, you have called us by name
Which of you will seek my fullness?
Which of you will dare to believe?
Hidden manna in the hands of the weak You say, come to me, my children
Ask of me in earnest expectation and receive
Leper standing on the edge of the crowd
Crying, if you're willing, Lord, you can make me clean
You reached out, laid your hand on his shame
In a moment, every stain disappeared like a dream
You whispered, go your way, not back to the priest
pleased but deeper into the heart of the unseen so here we are trembling but we rise again
dust on our knees yet you call us your friends every faltering step you still come in
faith like fire in the wind i will reach for the hem of your garment i will cry out your name in
In the storm, I will fall at your feet and surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For you said, come believe in and receive it all
You said, come believe in and you will be made whole
When you look in my eyes, let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
10 were cleansed as they walked in your word
Go show yourselves to the priests
And as they went they were healed
But one turned back with a shout and a song
Fell down giving glory
Every wound revealed
A stranger, a foreigner, a Samaritan heart
Found the door into the mystery
You sealed Roman soldier with a servant in pain
Said just speak the word and it shall be done
You marveled at a faith that broke every wall
A Gentile heart that trusted the Holy One
You said, not even Israel has such faith as this
And the healing came at once
So teach my soul to trust beyond my sight
To cling to you when shadows steal the light
To run back to your feet and hold on tight
Till your joy breaks through the night
I will reach for the hem of your garment
I will cry out your name in the storm
I will fall at your feet and surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For you said come believe in and receive it all
You said come believe in and you will be made whole
When you look in my eyes let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
Oh, keep me from the crowd that only touches but never believes
From the dark that returns to the mire, from the heart that retreats
Let me be the one who turns around to fall at your feet
To give you glory with my every breath in sorrow and in peace
When the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on the earth?
Let it be in my voice, let it burn in my words
Let it sing in my weakness, let it shout in my tears
Childlike trust through the trembling years
So I cast down my fear, my religion, my pride
I step out of the line just to walk by your side
You say come near my beloved, come abide
And I believe, I believe
I will reach for the hem of your garment
I will cry out your name in the storm
I will fall at your feet and surrender
Till my heart is forever reborn
For you said come believe it and receive it all
You said come believe it and you will be made whole
When you look in my eyes let it all be known
That my faith has made me whole
Oh, earnest expectation, I lift my eyes. Hidden manna falling from the sky. You reward all who diligently seek your face.
Find in me, Lord, a holy faith
Find in me, Lord, a holy faith
